newsitem.title: USA: Japan wants to work with US to dampen forex swings.
newsitem.headline: Japan wants to work with US to dampen forex swings.

text.p: Japanese Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka voiced hopes on Friday that the United States and Japan can work together to dampen currency market swings, eliciting an expression of interest from Washington.

"We hope to work together with you ... so that the market will not fluctuate so very much," Mitsuzuka told U.S. Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin at the start of a bilateral meeting here ahead of the Group of Seven annual summit.
"If we can figure out how to do that, I'm interested," Rubin replied, laughing.
Speaking through an interpreter, Mitsuzuka also told Rubin that economic deregulation is moving forward in Japan.
Reporters and photographers were allowed in to the meeting briefly to take pictures of the two men.
